name: Gojo
skill: Passive, Infinity: skill damage can't reach Gojo. Basic attacks wear down his Infinity (250 + 60% AP); once broken it returns after 15s. Blue: raises the Blue flag for 2.5s. His next basic attack launches the Blue orb at its target (40 + 40% AP), which collapses the instant it lands into a black hole that yanks nearby enemies to its centre (60 + 80% AP, stronger pull and 100 + 80% AP from level 3). The flag is used up and Blue recharges in 10s. With the Red flag also up, that attack becomes Hollow Purple instead.
skill2: Red: raises the Red flag for 2.5s. His next basic attack fires the Red blast: a fast piercing shot that shoves everything in its path (40 + 50% AP) and explodes at the end of its range, blasting enemies around that spot away (60 + 70% AP). The flag is used up and Red recharges in 8s. Inside his own domain he uses them on the sealed enemies right away, Purple first: with both ready they combine into Hollow Purple; a lone Blue or Red fires on its own after 0.75 s. Hollow Purple: with both flags up, his next basic attack winds up for 0.57s, then fires a huge, slow orb that crosses the map (260 + 220% AP), blasting back everyone it hits, and the recoil knocks Gojo back. Both flags are used up and Blue and Red recharge 50% slower for 21s.
ult: Unlimited Void: the moment Gojo presses it, a seal spreads out from him with the ring. Every enemy the ring reaches is sealed on the spot (can't move, attack or use skills) until the domain closes; it reaches the edge as the domain is conjured. The domain stays where it opened. Void Overload also cripples crowd-control-immune champions: they can't move, barely attack or deal damage, and their cooldowns almost freeze. While it is open, nothing from outside can hurt or crowd-control Gojo. With the native "Gojo domain rules" mod: his closest teammate inside stays free and protected, every other teammate inside is stunned, crowd-control immunity is ignored, nobody can get in until it closes, and once it's conjured its edge is a wall that those caught inside can't be knocked or dragged through. Slow cast while Infinity is up, fast cast when it is broken. Slow: conjured in 2.5s (Gojo is locked for only 0.5s), everyone inside is sealed for 6.5s from the press, then Gojo and his free teammate get +150% cooldown speed, +50% damage, +25% move speed, +25% attack speed for 10s. Fast: conjured in 0.75s (Gojo is locked for only 0.25s), everyone inside is sealed for 2.75s from the press, then Gojo and his free teammate get +150% cooldown speed, +25% damage, +40% move speed, +40% attack speed for 10s. Cooldown 60s.
